USERS: Dr. ########## MESSAGE HISTORY - XX-XX-XXXX CO--UROTPIE-D -- [DATE ... UNKNOWN] =====================================================================
so, it's a bit of an understatement to say that butchering the mixture of this synthesized hormone could result in something truly horrifying.
it's a lot of pressure, yeah?
i've devoted myself to knowing, sure but ...
but why does it feel like I'm being a bit too risky all of a sudden?
well, I might as well be accurate if I'm creating something that could either revolutionize us ... or end us.
of the various hormones, enzymes, dynestrogen relica makes up a majority of the compound:
{{red|Dynestrogen}} : 74.3
remember, this synthetic hormone engages the deoxyribonucleic system, stimulating individual molecular reintegration while incurring only minimal-to-minor losses in cellular stability or rouge-cellar pathogenesis.
one tick, one gram out of alignment. And ... well. Let's rather not imagine what will happen if the genetic leash that maintains our individual flesh was ... broken, and given freedom to grow, and consume.
... what the hell am I doing?
USERS: DR. ########## MESSAGE HISTORY - XX-XX-XXXX CO--UROTPIE-D -- [DATE ... UNKNOWN] =====================================================================
got chewed out ... dragged by our lead professor.
i just ... professed my doubts, we take a little more care. more trials. more technical hypothetical approaches.
but no.
i'm ... being cowardly, apparently.
{{orange|Mychoglobulin}} : 56.7
i got a bad feeling. and i'm just getting started. what the hell do I do?
mychoglobulin helps to settle the exciter that stimulates cell growth in the compounds final structure.
...
USERS: DR. ########## MESSAGE HISTORY - XX-XX-XXXX CO--UROTPIE-D -- [DATE ... UNKNOWN] =====================================================================
so, even Dr. Yoltum seems to agree. met with him yesterday, told him my plan. to stall the project out--lose enough funding. let it drop.
we both agree, its just not worth it.
i have to get the others to see, they're all mil-tec officers, science division.
{{yellow|Ultraglycocyn}} : 32.0
helps to stimulate genetic buffering, allowing for synaptic memory expansion and cell evolution.
USERS: DR. ########## MESSAGE HISTORY - XX-XX-XXXX CO--UROTPIE-D -- [DATE ... UNKNOWN] =====================================================================
i got a few of the other's to fall along, but Xeveye is ... skeptical.
he looks up to the lead. it'll be hard to get him to stop sucking up to that egotistical asshole.
oh, speaking of asshole.
{{green|Zetanutriena}} : 25.5
engaging intense spontaneous cellular recombination requires a crap-ton of nutrients. pun intended. in any situation this much cellular reconstruction would require so much energy that you'd need to ingest ... and expel, many tons worth of sustenance to the fuel the process.
or use this, zetanutriena. a slow-release super-food for one's cells. typically, you can't just inject it and be fine--instant fatal vitamin toxicity overdose--the dosage makes the poison, you know--but in this case, the zetanutriena can burn away before it toxifies the body through hypervitamitosis.
USERS: DR. ########## MESSAGE HISTORY - XX-XX-XXXX CO--UROTPIE-D -- [DATE ... UNKNOWN] =====================================================================
i managed to convince a few others, we're working together to stall the lead's attempts to slow down our process. if we can get this branch to fail, then we can move on with other projects. put this nightmare behind us.
{{cyan|Psycholuceum}} : 13.1
derived from special fungi, psycholuceum engages the chemical bridge between our mind and our cells-its the communicator--taking one's thoughts and intentions and relaying the intentions to the cells.
USERS: DR. ########## MESSAGE HISTORY - XX-XX-XXXX CO--UROTPIE-D -- [DATE ... UNKNOWN] =====================================================================
... Xeveye ...
he told the lead and the lead brought in the military. i've been separated and put under watch. told to continue my experiments. and to do so promptly.
I haven't heard ... from Yoltum ...
{{blue|Xaldazium}} : 7.7
prevents intense shock to the dna spectrum and neural structure, causing cerebral-death if unmanaged.
USERS: DR. ########## MESSAGE HISTORY - XX-XX-XXXX CO--UROTPIE-D -- [DATE ... UNKNOWN] =====================================================================
the fool! i told him he could trust me! i could synthesize the VITAE compound using a gene-distillery! but he doesn't trust me anymore, he thinks i'll betray him.
he brought in Xev instead! he's the clumsiest operator i've ever met. i've trained operators with more finesse than him!
dear god ... if just one of those metrics is off ...
{{magenta|Arsplicium}} : 0.1
USERS: DR. AFRON NIELST - LEAD SCIENCE OFFICER MESSAGE HISTORY - XX-XX-XXXX CO--UROTPIE-D -- [DATE ... UNKNOWN] =====================================================================
I awoke this morning to a message in my inbox, we've been greenlit to move on with the final stages of Project LIEF.
Finally, a moment of true exposure for my recent experiments. A moment to be, vindicated and recognized for the truly revolutionary deeds I've done here.
We've, with my guidance of course, synthesized several key compounds that hold the mechanisms neccesary to biological unlockings so incredible, that flesh might finally revere thought.
If we can perfect this solution, we can create a tonic that when taken, allows one to sculpt themselves with their very minds.
The only thing holding me back, are the nitwits they assigned me. Sure Dr. ######### has some genius when it comes to her chemical synthesis skills. But they're a bit too ... altruistic? Humble? All 'hypothetical trials before clinical trials.'
What a child.
Science Officer Yoltum's a lazy bum, doing only what they are told and not putting in the effort to explore beyond their ability. Ignorant boy.
Assistant Science Officer Xeveye is ... tolerable. They praise my incredible genius--as they should--and speak with utmost respect while in my presence and presumably outside of it as well. He's a bit naive. But, I'll allow his presence for now.
The rest of the crew are a bunch of fools. Drabble, empty heads that only follow directions. But I'll make use of this lot. My road to glory was paved with agonies, but it was worth it. It was worth the wait, the time, the sweat, the blood. The humiliation at the hands of this society.
I will be the herald of a new era.
USERS: DR. AFRON NIELST - LEAD SCIENCE OFFICER MESSAGE HISTORY - XX-XX-XXXX CO--UROTPIE-D -- [DATE ... UNKNOWN] =====================================================================
Dr. ########, all dour-eyed, whining like a sheep over the "dangers" of the clinical experiments. We've kept our biosynthization methods within scope. Somewhat. And though yes some of the recent clinical test on the vermin have resulted in, how shall I say this, 'lively tumors.' We've managed to curt the cliffedge with our experiments. Sure, the cells are revolting against the forced reconstitution efforts. But the compound is ... dynamic. DR. ######## says it could be a catastrophe, a "world ending event".
Ha ... what an imagination.
The girl thinks this place wouldn't be qaurantined and glassed to high-hell before that even happens. Fret not I say, we are one of the most secure and advanced biogenetics firms in the world, the military in our pockets offers security and personnel unrivalled by our peers. Perks like, administrative freedoms, enhanced emenities, and a security force that could vaporize an armada. Some talking tumors aren't going to stop us, no-- me, from achieving the glory that I deserve. I accused the girl of being a coward, "how did you even become a scientist? too busy sticking hypotheticals to paper and never practicing the practical element!"
Got a good laugh out of me, and Dr. Xeveye.
The others were too focused on their work to grasp my humor.
I guess I can't be too hard on the child. They've proven to have the technical ability. All that pencil-pushing made her accurate at least, and she managed to crack the first and second compound thresholds we needed for the serum.
If these idiots can maintain focus for a moment, we might actually finish this project within the projected time scope.
